title: CDN and application cache
purpose: Show CDN direct static path independently from dynamic app caching and primary/replica database roles.
alt: 정적 콘텐츠의 CDN 경로와 동적 요청의 웹·애플리케이션 캐시·DB 경로 분리
requiredChecks: Client requests static assets directly from CDN and dynamic requests through Load balancer to Web tier.
Application cache is accessed by Web tier, while CDN and application cache are separate systems.
Web tier writes to Primary and reads from Replica, with one-way Primary→Replica replication; DB reads on cache miss clearly qualified.
DNS lookup resolves endpoints separately and no HTTP request is sent to DNS.
